title: Add scaffolding progress display to NewProjectWizard
description: After the user completes wizard selections, show a sequential progress screen: spinner while scaffolding, then installing dependencies, then initializing git. Each step shows a checkmark when done.
acceptanceCriteria: After scaffolding: shows 'Installing dependencies...' with spinner
After npm install: shows 'Initializing git...' with spinner
Each completed step shows a green checkmark instead of spinner
All three steps appear sequentially (not simultaneously)

steps.details: Add state: { progressStep: 'scaffolding' | 'installing' | 'git' | 'done' | null }. When onComplete is called, set progressStep to 'scaffolding' and start the scaffold process.
Create a local ProgressStep component that accepts { label, done }: renders <Spinner> if not done, <Text color='green'>✓</Text> if done, followed by the label text.

When progressStep is set, render: <Box flexDirection='column'><ProgressStep label={`Scaffolding ${projectName}...`} done={progressStep !== 'scaffolding'} />{progressStep !== 'scaffolding' && <ProgressStep label='Installing dependencies...' done={['git','done'].includes(progressStep)} />}</Box>

steps.description: Run scaffold steps asynchronously and update progress
steps.details: Use useEffect to run the scaffold steps after the wizard completes. After each step (scaffold, npm install, git init), update progressStep state to advance the UI. Pass onStepComplete callbacks to the scaffold function.

technicalNotes: Ink Spinner is imported from 'ink-spinner' — it provides a built-in terminal spinner animation
Use useEffect with an async IIFE to run async operations inside React components
